subject: ela
cluster: Research to Build and Present Knowledge

items.prompt:
Using a source's exact words in quotation marks is:
A) quoting
B) paraphrasing
C) summarizing

steps: Word for word. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Restating an idea in your own words is:
A) paraphrasing
B) quoting
C) copying

When you paraphrase a source, you:
A) still must cite it
B) never cite it
C) can claim it as yours

Why avoid OVERRELIANCE on a single source?
A) several sources give a broader, more balanced, more reliable basis
B) one source is always enough
C) more sources is worse
items.answer: A) several sources give a broader, more balanced, more reliable basis

solution.answer: A) several sources give a broader, more balanced, more reliable basis

items.prompt:
Assessing a source's STRENGTHS AND LIMITATIONS means:
A) weighing what it offers and where it falls short for your task
B) reading only the title
C) ignoring its weaknesses
items.answer: A) weighing what it offers and where it falls short for your task

solution.answer: A) weighing what it offers and where it falls short for your task

items.prompt:
Which search terms are MOST effective for finding how the electoral college works?
A) 'electoral college process US elections'
B) 'voting stuff'
C) 'cool government'

A student quotes one blog in every paragraph and cites nothing else. The main problems are:
A) overreliance on one source and weak sourcing
B) too many citations
C) too much paraphrasing
items.answer: A) overreliance on one source and weak sourcing

solution.answer: A) overreliance on one source and weak sourcing

items.prompt:
Which source is MOST authoritative for a report on constitutional law?
A) a law journal article by a constitutional scholar
B) an anonymous social media post
C) a satirical website
items.answer: A) a law journal article by a constitutional scholar

solution.answer: A) a law journal article by a constitutional scholar
